comparison: Exact per-row equality of all fixture identity, football counters, planned diagnostics, suitability, preferences, physical transition clocks, workload, rotation traces and initial/final scenario outcome fields. Only elapsedMs and canonicalStateHash are omitted; elapsed time varies under CPU contention and the canonical full-state hash changes with statistics watermark metadata.
scope: 210 rerun after fixtures: 105 ten-minute tactical rows and 105 twelve-second synthetic rows; this is an equality result for the stated deterministic matrix, not a proof for arbitrary unseen fixtures.
